alt.text: At a school creativity fair, two student teams present a solar-powered model city and an ecological garden sculpture side by side while teachers, families, and classmates admire both projects.

anatomy.notes: The many children and adults have coherent faces, bodies, limbs, and clothing; no material anatomical distortions are visible despite the dense crowd and partial occlusions.

meaning.notes: Two student teams present clearly different projects side by side: a solar-powered model city and an ecological garden sculpture. Teachers, children, and families visibly admire both, conveying that each has its own strengths.

object_structure.notes: The solar city has recognizable buildings, roads, trees, a bus, pool, and rooftop solar panels; the garden sculpture has a bird form, flowers, rocks, foliage, and a small stream, all distinct and readable.

perspective_physics.notes: Both tabletop exhibits sit on stable covered tables with consistent scale and perspective; buildings, roads, plants, rocks, water, tents, and crowd placement are spatially coherent with consistent daylight.

pose_contact.notes: Presenters gesture toward their respective displays while surrounding viewers clap, point, or give thumbs-up. Hands, tablets, display tables, and foreground poses have plausible contact.

style.notes: Consistent warm watercolor, colored-pencil, and graphite children's educational illustration style with paper texture throughout.

text_brand_watermark.notes: No readable text, prominent brand marks, or watermark is visible.
